description: Deliberately empty. The window shows the remote web app, which gets no access to native commands: no files, no shell, no opener, no updater, no dialogs. Links are opened from Rust (see src/main.rs), window size and position are saved by the window-state plugin on the Rust side, and the update check and its one Restart now / Later question run from Rust too (src/update.rs): plugins called from Rust need no permission here. The one grant the page has is added at start-up in src/main.rs (drag_capability), because the app's address is only known at build time: moving the window by its overlay title bar band and zooming it with a double click there (core:window:allow-start-dragging, core:window:allow-internal-toggle-maximize), for the app's own origin in the main window only. A second runtime grant, also only for the app's own origin in the main window, lets the page call the four Mac fetches it commands (src/mac_fetch/mod.rs capability, docs/CONTRACTS.md §33.2): mac_fetch_start, mac_fetch_status, mac_fetch_upload and mac_fetch_cancel. Nothing else.
